artifact: H6-R2 Grove body-datum correction and rejected placement candidate
scope: Correct F.Fab body and engineering F.CrtYd only; preserve all six solder-land records, their four electrical numbers, MPN and nets. No native board, schematic or placement change.

evidence.author: Shenzhen NS-Tech Co., Ltd.; published by Seeed Studio
evidence.section: Sheet 1, body, section and land pattern; full page visually reviewed
evidence.facts: Body nominally 12.0 by 9.10 mm; mating side opposite the signal solder-tail row. No connector-specific PCB-edge datum is prescribed.

evidence.author: Seeed Studio
evidence.section: F.Fab body and exact signal/anchor rows

evidence.author: Seeed Studio
evidence.section: Connector identification and PCB Layout Tips
evidence.facts: SKU 320110032 is 1125R-SMT-4P. General advice keeps the connector on the PCB with at least 0.5 mm copper-to-edge clearance; this is not an exact mating-face datum.

alignment.transform: Rotate official CAD 180 degrees, then translate Y into the preserved Leshy2 solder-land frame.
alignment.precision_limit: Row disagreement is CAD rounding, not manufacturing tolerance. Derived micrometre-scale decimals are nominal registration arithmetic only.

engineering_courtyard.policy: At least 0.25 mm beyond nominal body and preserved copper; not copied from an unrelated package and not a manufacturer-mandated courtyard. Body tolerances and plug access remain separate integration checks.

native_candidate_review.method: Load native PCB and corrected library into KiCad in memory; add temporary footprint and test same-side courtyard intersections. No SaveBoard or native replacement.
native_candidate_review.coordinate_frame: RF exterior/native XY; not clamshell world XY or mirrored inner-view XY
limits: The accepted exterior X=57 cannot be applied in isolation while the current USB, C29 and U2 poses remain; reconcile the complete lower interface row first.
B180 points the mating face toward increasing native Y. Rotating at the old Y=145.45 instead would put solder lands beyond the Y=150 board edge.
Nominal 0.515-mm copper-edge clearance is not a full tolerance, cable-plug, enclosure, soldering or DRC qualification. The engineering courtyard extending beyond the PCB is not itself a waiver.
